headline: Unbeaten Texas travels to Alabama seeking statement road win
subhead: The nation's top-ranked team faces a five-win Alabama squad desperate to salvage its season.

xFactor.why: Alabama's ability to generate pressure and force mistakes will determine whether Texas's offense can maintain the rhythm it showed dismantling USC.

keyMatchup: Texas's offensive line execution against Alabama's front seven will dictate field position and time of possession in a game where momentum shifts quickly.
body: Texas arrives undefeated after a decisive 41-11 demolition of USC, a performance that underscored the Longhorns' depth and explosive capability on offense. The offense moved with precision and patience, and the defense suffocated a ranked opponent. Now comes the road test every championship contender must face: a venue that doesn't travel well, against a team with little to lose and everything to prove.

Alabama's 29-23 victory over Penn State showed the program still possesses competitive teeth, even at 5-5. The Crimson Tide's secondary proved it can match up in tight coverage, and their ability to limit mistakes late in that game suggests they understand how to keep contests close. However, Texas's efficiency and ball security—hallmarks of a top-tier team—should prove too much to overcome, even in a hostile environment. The Longhorns have the talent and poise to execute a road game script that keeps Alabama's offense starved for drives.
